description: Check whether an email address is real and safe to send to. Says if it will arrive or bounce (deliverable, undeliverable, risky, unknown), flags throwaway, role-based (info@, sales@), catch-all and free-mail addresses, and suggests a fix for typos like gmail.con. Use it before sending outreach or to clean up a sign-up list. Price: $0.02 per successful call; failed calls are free.

api_key.description: Your Unstuck API key, if this connection has none. Leave empty to try free tools or to get a key and payment link.

email.description: The email address to check, e.g. "jane@acme.com".

name: email_verify

charged_usd.description: Amount charged for this call, USD.

checked_by.description: local_precheck = answered by free local checks.

did_you_mean.description: Suggested correction for a likely typo.

reason.description: Why, e.g. mailbox_exists, invalid_syntax, disposable_domain, catch_all.

status.description: Whether mail to it will arrive.

title: Verify an Email Address
